text:
irene: quick heads-up: discovered plaintext transport swap at runtime can bypass redaction in node sampleapp. repro below.

irene: repro steps:
```
1) run samples/node-telemetry with LOG_FORMAT=json and OTEL log hook enabled
2) at runtime flip to LOG_FORMAT=pretty (admin endpoint /config)
3) trigger a failing downstream -> client retry emits logs
4) structured sink: reqId=null, pretty stdout: 'retry attempt=2 reqId=req-Z'
```

oliver: which logger + pretty printer? pino + pino-pretty? versions?

irene: pino@8 + pino-pretty 7. the redaction transform is attached to serializers at init time. when we hot-swap transports we recreate the pretty stream but forget to reattach the serializer transform.

sam: paste the noisy lines you saw?

irene: ```
ERROR Downstream - request failed: 502 {"user":"marie","reqId":"req-Z","err":"econnreset"}
DEBUG Retry - retry attempt=2 reqId=req-Z
{"ts":"...","level":"DEBUG","reqId":null}
```

oliver: interesting: structured JSON has reqId null, but pretty line leaks it. also note retry helper is embedding reqId inline in the message string which makes it visible to pretty printer even if serializers are applied.

sam: snippet from retry helper: `logger.debug(`retry ${i} id=${ctx.reqId}`)` <- this bypasses pino metadata.

irene: yup. root cause is twofold: 1) transport rebind drops transform, 2) inline token in message text.

oliver: quick fixes: a) ensure transport swap reuses existing stream instances or reattaches serializer transforms, b) update retry helper to pass reqId as metadata: `logger.debug('retry %d', i, { reqId: ctx.reqId })`, c) as belt-and-suspenders, run redaction on formatted string as final pass (cheap prefix check first).

sam: parity note: python SDK uses a global pre-formatter hook so it never missed pretty output. node needs parity. mark as sdk-parity and telemetry.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-5100 - runtime transport swap -> pretty output redaction bypass - assignee: devex-oncall.

irene: I'll open a small PR in samples/node-telemetry with a failing integration that toggles LOG_FORMAT at runtime and asserts no raw reqId on stdout. will also change retry helper to structured metadata in the sample.

devex-bot: :thumbsup: labels added: bug, telemetry, sdk-node, sdk-parity.

oliver: long term: we should centralize redaction into a logging pipeline stage that's invariant to transports (pre-formatter). but watch perf: run a cheap substring check for "reqId=" before regex redact.

sam: also found traceparent lost across async retry boundaries in this flow; make sure retry preserves active span context. will add a small test.

irene: thanks all. short-term mitigation for customers: avoid embedding sensitive ids inline in message templates; pass them as structured context so redaction hooks can catch them.
